snippet.title: Ratchet & Clank 2: Going Commando (2003) - Gameplay Trailer #2 | PS2
snippet.description:
Ratchet & Clank 2: Going Commando, also known as Ratchet & Clank 2: Locked and Loaded, is a 3D action-platform game in the Ratchet & Clank series, released in 2003 by Insomniac Games and Sony Computer Entertainment for PlayStation 2.

From the creators of Ratchet & Clank comes the next installment in this sci-fi action-adventure series. Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando features more than 50 imaginative weapons and gadgets. The more things you blow up, the stronger Ratchet becomes, and the more advanced your weapons become.

Take part in all-new side challenges, destroy hordes of enemies in gladiator arenas, upgrade your ship and take on enemies in space combat, or leave your competitors eating your dust in high-speed challenges. Are you up for it?
-----------------------------------------------
Svenska:

Ratchet & Clank 2: Going Commando, även känt som Ratchet & Clank 2: Locked and Loaded, är ett 3D-actionplattformsspel i Ratchet & Clank-serien som släpptes 2003 av Insomniac Games och Sony Computer Entertainment till PlayStation 2.

Från skaparna av Ratchet & Clank kommer nästa del i denna sci-fi-baserade actionäventyrsserie. Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando innehåller över 50 fantasifulla vapen och prylar. Ju fler saker du spränger, desto starkare blir Ratchet och desto mer avancerade blir dina vapen.

Delta i helt nya sidoutmaningar, bekämpa horder av fiender i gladiatorarenor, uppgradera ditt rymdskepp och ta dig an fiender i rymdstrider, eller lämna dina konkurrenter bakom dig i fartfyllda utmaningar. Är du redo?
